perspective.description: The narrative voice or speaker identity through which the song is delivered.
perspective.parsimony_rule: Select 1 primary dominant code. Only select a 2nd code if an equally prominent dual perspective exists.

codes.label: Moral Judgement
codes.definition: Voice holding humans and society ethically accountable, identifying injustice, and passing moral verdict.
codes.inclusion: Ethical indictment, attributing guilt, demanding moral accountability or societal reckoning.

codes.label: Systemic Critique
codes.definition: Focuses on structural systems of oppression (capitalism, state subsidies, institutional industry).
codes.inclusion: Critiques of subsidies, consumer culture, corporate greed, and institutionalized exploitation.

codes.label: Animal Advocate
codes.definition: Voice of conscience, empathy, and moral appeal on behalf of non-human animals.
codes.inclusion: Appeals to empathy, calls for changes in animal treatment, universal compassion, peaceful vegan advocacy.

codes.label: Direct Action
codes.definition: Activist voice documenting or urging liberation raids, cage breaking, sabotage, or underground resistance.
codes.inclusion: References to breaking cages, burning labs, underground ALF networks, militant rescue.

codes.label: Witness
codes.definition: First-hand observation and documentation of slaughter, trauma, and suffering.
codes.inclusion: Descriptions of watching slaughter/atrocities, feeling haunted by witnessed suffering.

codes.label: Captive Animal
codes.definition: First-person voice of the caged, farmed, lab, or slaughtered animal.
codes.inclusion: First-person accounts of being caged, commodified, processed, or killed.

codes.label: Animal Revolutionary
codes.definition: First-person animal voice expressing active resistance, defiance, or retaliation against humans.
codes.inclusion: Animals threatening retaliation, expressing pride in wild nature, organizing animal rebellion.

codes.label: Eco-advocate
codes.definition: Warning of ecological collapse, planetary devastation, and species extinction.
codes.inclusion: Warnings of deforestation, resource depletion, climate collapse, and planetary breakdown.

codes.label: Analyst
codes.definition: Objective, detached, scientific or matter-of-fact description of biology or slaughter.
codes.inclusion: Scientific descriptions of biology or cold, factual descriptions of dissection/slaughter.

codes.label: Storyteller
codes.definition: Grounded in personal journey, daily choices, dietary reflection, or interpersonal narrative.
codes.inclusion: Descriptions of personal transition, daily encounters, meal reflections, casual storytelling.

codes.label: Oppressor
codes.definition: Adopts the voice or persona of the slaughterer, hunter, or human supremacist.
codes.inclusion: First-person expressions of human superiority, right to exploit, or execution of slaughter.

lyrical_tone.description: The rhetorical posture, artistic attitude, and delivery style of the lyrics.
lyrical_tone.parsimony_rule: Select 1 primary dominant code. Only select a 2nd code if an equally prominent secondary posture exists.

codes.label: Indictment
codes.definition: Accusatory, righteous posture framing actions as severe moral crimes.

codes.label: Systemic
codes.definition: Tone targeting institutional power, state enforcement, corporate greed, and capitalism.

codes.label: Resistance
codes.definition: Unyielding, rebellious posture of active resistance and readiness to fight back.

codes.label: Vengeance
codes.definition: Hostile, confrontational tone with direct threats, violent imagery, or vengeance.

codes.label: Cynicism
codes.definition: Weary, exhausted, or deeply cynical tone reflecting hopelessness and broken trust.

codes.label: Mobilizing
codes.definition: Urgent, rallying tone designed to mobilize listeners to immediate collective action.

codes.label: Fatalism
codes.definition: Prophetic, doom-laden tone warning of inevitable ecological collapse or cosmic retribution.

codes.label: Satirical
codes.definition: Sarcastic, mocking, or humorous tone using snark or parody against meat culture.

codes.label: Philosophical
codes.definition: Educational, rational tone using logical arguments, health facts, or ethical discourse.

codes.label: Introspective
codes.definition: Deeply personal, introspective tone focusing on self-guilt, personal struggle, or grief.

codes.label: Outrage
codes.definition: Highly emotional, raw, visceral grief, distress, and horror at suffering.

codes.label: Detachment
codes.definition: Cold, sterile, objective tone describing violent or surgical acts with technical precision.

codes.label: Questioning
codes.definition: Questioning tone challenging cultural assumptions or interrogating listener beliefs.

codes.label: Equivalence
codes.definition: Philosophical tone leveling human and animal biology ('flesh and blood is you and me').

codes.label: Conflicted
codes.definition: Self-aware, pragmatic tone acknowledging gaps between ideals and personal habits/society.

intensity.description: The energy level, emotional extremity, and urgency of the lyrical delivery.

codes.label: Extreme
codes.definition: Explosive, furious, or unhinged; violent breakdown, screaming rage, visceral horror, or death threats.

codes.label: Forceful
codes.definition: Urgent, assertive, impassioned; high conviction and rallying calls without explosive chaos.

codes.label: Moderate
codes.definition: Measured, conversational, didactic; steady rhythm and clear delivery without aggressive pressure.

codes.label: Subdued
codes.definition: Quiet, introspective, melancholic, or ambient; understated delivery, whisper, or gentle acoustic reflection.

clarity.description: How directly or indirectly animal exploitation, slaughter, or vegan ethics are communicated.

codes.label: Explicit
codes.definition: Directly and unambiguously names veganism, animal rights/liberation, slaughter, or specific animal abuse. Leaves zero doubt about the subject.

codes.label: Contextual
codes.definition: Clearly about animal suffering or eating animals, but uses descriptive narrative context, storytelling, or euphemism rather than formal vegan terminology.

codes.label: Allegorical
codes.definition: Uses metaphor, fables, anthropomorphic role reversals, or symbolic imagery that represents animal exploitation indirectly.

codes.label: Ambiguous / Subtle
codes.definition: Cryptic, veiled, or generalized ethical references where the animal liberation meaning is implied or open to dual interpretations.

codes.label: Absent / Incidental
codes.definition: Animal exploitation is not addressed, or only appears as an incidental, non-thematic idiom.

focus_amount.description: The degree to which animal liberation/vegan ethics forms the central thesis versus a secondary or minor theme.

codes.label: Primary
codes.definition: The entire song is centered on animal liberation / non-human ethics as its core thesis.

codes.label: Secondary
codes.definition: Features a dedicated verse, major section, or co-equal pillar alongside other political/social themes.

codes.label: Peripheral
codes.definition: A brief 1–2 line mention or list item in a song primarily about another topic.

codes.label: Minor Mention
codes.definition: An incidental, passing reference, idiom, or background detail without substantive ethical focus.

target_audience.description: The specific individuals, groups, institutions, or societal entities addressed or criticized.
target_audience.parsimony_rule: Select 1 primary dominant code. Only select a 2nd code if an equally prominent secondary target exists.

codes.label: Meat & Dairy Consumers
codes.definition: Individuals who actively purchase, consume, or wear animal-derived products.

codes.label: Bystander Public
codes.definition: General public who are aware of cruelty but choose to look away, remain silent, or tolerate injustice.

codes.label: Agribusiness & Industry
codes.definition: Corporate entities, agribusiness, factory farms, slaughterhouses, and capitalist structures.

codes.label: Vivisection Labs
codes.definition: Labs, medical researchers, and pharmaceutical companies performing animal testing.

codes.label: State & Ideology
codes.definition: Governments, legal systems, police, patriarchy, fascism, and oppressive dogmas.

codes.label: Hunters & Abusers
codes.definition: Individuals directly inflicting physical violence, hunting, circuses, or slaughter.

codes.label: Human Society at Large
codes.definition: Broad species-level critique targeting the human race and human superiority.

codes.label: Hypocritical Animal Lovers
codes.definition: Groups claiming high moral standing (pro-lifers, pet owners) while ignoring animal slaughter.

codes.label: Youth & Future Generations
codes.definition: Children, youth, and future generations representing hope or innocent inheritors of crisis.

codes.label: Oppressed Groups
codes.definition: Captive animals, third-world peasants, or marginalized populations targeted as allies.

codes.label: Personal Friend / Self
codes.definition: Specific individuals, the self in the mirror, or personal friends/caregivers.

codes.label: General Audience
codes.definition: No specific target audience explicitly identified or instrumental.

emotions.description: The primary emotional tenor and affective states conveyed by the song as a complete work.
emotions.parsimony_rule: Select 1 to 3 dominant key emotions that best reflect the song's emotional arc.

codes.label: Outrage
codes.definition: Intense moral anger, indignation, and fury at slaughter, cruelty, and systemic injustice.

codes.label: Defiance
codes.definition: Rebellious resolve, militant courage, and refusal to submit to unjust laws or oppressive norms.

codes.label: Vengeance
codes.definition: Hostile desire, anger, or threat of physical retaliation against animal abusers and exploiters.

codes.label: Solidarity
codes.definition: Feeling of collective unity, mutual loyalty, and fellowship with non-human animals and fellow activists.

codes.label: Grief
codes.definition: Deep sorrow, mourning, and heartbreak for animal victims, lost lives, and planetary devastation.

codes.label: Horror
codes.definition: Shock, terror, and visceral dread induced by slaughterhouses, blood, butchery, and torture.

codes.label: Disgust
codes.definition: Physical and visceral nausea and revulsion at eating animal flesh, corpses, and body parts.

codes.label: Misanthropy
codes.definition: Contempt, bitterness, and revulsion toward humanity as an inherently corrupt, cruel, or parasitic species.

codes.label: Dread
codes.definition: Looming terror and anxious anticipation of ecological collapse, planetary ruin, or inevitable doom.

codes.label: Despair
codes.definition: Hopeless void, feeling crushed or overwhelmed by the staggering scale of institutional slaughter.

codes.label: Disillusionment
codes.definition: Weariness, cynicism, and loss of faith in human promises, corporate greenwashing, and societal progress.

codes.label: Yearning
codes.definition: Anguished longing for freedom, peace, sanctuary, or relief from suffering.

codes.label: Guilt
codes.definition: Remorse, self-blame, or complicity over past consumption or failing to intervene against cruelty.

codes.label: Shame
codes.definition: Painful humiliation and embarrassment at belonging to a human species that inflicts such barbarism.

codes.label: Compassion
codes.definition: Tender empathy, universal kinship, and active loving care for all sentient living beings.

codes.label: Hope
codes.definition: Optimistic faith, inspiration, and belief in the possibility of a liberated, cruelty-free vegan future.

codes.label: Joy
codes.definition: Exuberant celebration and triumph over animal rescues, sanctuary living, and empty cages.

sonic_energy.description: Perceptual measure of musical intensity, dynamic volume, distortion, and sound pressure level.

codes.label: Explosive
codes.definition: High-octane, heavy distortion, loud production, and maximum dynamic force (e.g. Hardcore, Grindcore, Metalcore).

codes.label: Energetic
codes.definition: Upbeat, energetic rhythm, punchy instrumentation, and lively production (e.g. Punk Rock, Fast Ska, Upbeat Rock).

codes.label: Moderate
codes.definition: Mid-tempo, balanced volume, steady acoustic/electric arrangement (e.g. Indie Rock, Mid-tempo Alternative).

codes.label: Subdued
codes.definition: Gentle, quiet production, intimate acoustic instruments, and subdued dynamics (e.g. Folk Ballads, Acoustic Solos, Ambient).

emotional_mood.description: Harmonic and emotional positivity conveyed by the musical arrangement and chord structures.

codes.label: Somber
codes.definition: Low positivity: minor-key, mournful, sad, elegiac, or desolate harmonic mood (e.g. Captivity Elegies, Slaughterhouse Laments).

codes.label: Tense
codes.definition: Mid-low positivity: serious, urgent, tense, or confrontational harmonic tone.

codes.label: Neutral
codes.definition: Moderate positivity: neutral, storytelling, or reflective harmonic background.

codes.label: Uplifting
codes.definition: High positivity: major-key, cheerful, bright, encouraging, or triumphant feel (e.g. Celebration of Vegan Life).

rhythmic_style.description: Rhythmic regularity, danceability, beat strength, and tempo momentum.

codes.label: Aggressive
codes.definition: Rapid blast beats, relentless double-kick barrage, thrash beats, and heavy breakdowns (e.g. Death Metal, Grindcore, Hardcore Punk).

codes.label: Driving
codes.definition: Driving rock/punk beat, punchy 4/4 forward momentum, and steady rhythmic pulse.

codes.label: Groove
codes.definition: Syncopated beat, danceable rhythm, swing, reggae skank, and hip-hop bounce (e.g. Reggae, Ska, Hip-Hop, Funk, Pop).

codes.label: Atmospheric
codes.definition: Loose beat structure, unmetered ambient passages, drone, spoken monologues, or non-rhythmic soundscapes.

acoustic_type.description: Primary instrumentation setup and acoustic vs electric/electronic sound spectrum.

codes.label: Acoustic
codes.definition: Unamplified acoustic instruments, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, and organic folk production.

codes.label: Hybrid
codes.definition: Blend of acoustic and electric/electronic instruments (e.g. acoustic guitar with electric drums/bass).

codes.label: Electric
codes.definition: Electric guitars, bass, synthesizers, distorted amplifiers, and heavy studio production.

vocal_delivery.description: Style of vocal presentation, ratio of spoken vs sung, and vocal technique.

codes.label: Harsh / Screamed
codes.definition: Screaming, death growls, hardcore shouting, and guttural barking (e.g. Earth Crisis, Cattle Decapitation, Architects).

codes.label: Melodic / Clean
codes.definition: Standard melodic singing, clean vocal lines, and harmonies (e.g. Folk, Pop, Melodic Punk, Indie).

codes.label: Mixed Delivery
codes.definition: Dynamic combination of clean singing and harsh screaming (e.g. Metalcore, Post-Hardcore) or singing with rap verses.

codes.label: Rap / Flow
codes.definition: Rhythmic hip-hop cadence, rhyming flow, and rap delivery (e.g. Vegan Hip-Hop, Grime).

codes.label: Spoken Word
codes.definition: Spoken word poetry, activist monologues, speeches, and dramatic readings.

codes.label: Documentary Sample
codes.definition: Audio samples from slaughterhouses, documentaries, speeches, or undercover footage embedded into the song.

codes.label: Instrumental
codes.definition: Purely musical arrangement without vocal performance.
